hunks.baseline: A dazzling outfit and an alluring smile. She approached me gracefully, like a peacock, and placed a hand on my shoulder.
hunks.sol: Dressed in dazzling clothes and wearing an alluring smile, she approached with the grace of a peacock and placed a hand on my shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “It feels like I had to fish for that compliment myself, but… fine. This is enough to pass. Coming all the way here after dropping everything I was doing was worth it.”
hunks.sol: “It feels like I had to fish for that compliment myself, but… fine. You pass. Dropping everything and rushing over here was worth it after all.”

hunks.baseline: As Wolhwa gave me one of her characteristic eye-smiles, a young beggar in shabby clothes approached from beside her with a displeased expression.
hunks.sol: As Wolhwa flashed me one of her signature eye-smiles, a young beggar in shabby clothes approached from beside her with a sour expression.

hunks.baseline: Three knots were tied together at his waist, symbolizing his position within the Beggars’ Sect.
hunks.sol: The cord at his waist, marking him as a disciple of the Beggars’ Sect, was tied into three knots.

hunks.baseline: In other words, he was a three-knot disciple of the Beggars’ Sect.

hunks.sol: “I’m the Heukgeol Beggar, head of the Beggars’ Sect’s Xi’an branch.”

hunks.sol: “I already know. You’re as strapping as I’d heard. With a face like that, you could easily earn dozens of silver nyang a day begging. Have you ever considered joining the Beggars’ Sect?”

hunks.baseline: “Well, forget it if you’re not interested. In any case, it seems someone who should be here is missing.”
hunks.sol: “Well, forget it if you’re not interested. More importantly, someone who ought to be here seems to be missing.”

hunks.sol: Heukgeol Beggar blew hard through his nose as he looked around. The moment he spotted his target, he shouted.

hunks.baseline: *That makes things even better. This should go smoothly.*
hunks.sol: *Even better. This should go smoothly.*

hunks.baseline: For someone else, however, it would be very bad news.
hunks.sol: For someone else, however, this was very bad news.

hunks.sol: I turned my head and found Hwangbo Eom’s face twisted with displeasure. The corners of my mouth rose of their own accord.

hunks.baseline: “If this is your first time meeting, you should at least exchange greetings. Both of them are major figures in Shaanxi Province.”
hunks.sol: “If this is your first time meeting, you should at least exchange greetings. Both of them do very important work here in Shaanxi Province.”

hunks.baseline: As I had expected, Hwangbo Eom already knew who they were. He bit his lip. His fingers twitched, and he looked desperate to draw the sword propped beside the table and swing it at someone.
hunks.sol: Just as I had expected, Hwangbo Eom already knew who they were. He bit his lip. His fingers twitched as though he wanted nothing more than to draw the sword propped beside the table and start swinging.

hunks.baseline: The eyes of the sly old man slowly turned cold.
hunks.sol: The sly old man’s eyes slowly turned cold.

hunks.baseline: “Indeed. I’m looking forward to whatever our Young Master Jin gets up to next, so my heart is already pounding.”
hunks.sol: “I know, right? My heart is already pounding with anticipation over what our Young Master Jin might do next.”

hunks.baseline: Hwangbo Eom raised his eyes sharply toward Wolhwa, who had spoken without warning.
hunks.sol: Hwangbo Eom glared sharply at Wolhwa, who had spoken without warning.

hunks.baseline: “This is not a matter for the Lower District Sect. I do not know why you came here, but… it would be best for you to withdraw at this point.”
hunks.sol: “This is not a matter for the Lower District Sect. I do not know why you came here, but… it would be best for you to withdraw now.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve already accepted a commission. Of course, the client is the Young Master Jin standing here. Isn’t that right?”
hunks.sol: “I’ve already accepted a commission. Of course, the client is Young Master Jin, standing right here. Isn’t that right?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, absolutely. Did you receive the silver nyang retainer I sent through the attendant?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, absolutely. Did you receive the advance I sent through the attendant?”

hunks.baseline: “Then withdraw. Unless you wish to make an enemy of our sect.”

hunks.sol: Hwangbo Eom looked back and forth between the two, then shouted like a thunderclap.

hunks.sol: “Enough excuses! Beggars’ Sect, get the hell out of here!”

hunks.sol: “Well now.”

hunks.sol: “Now, now, what do you mean, looting? I hear there’s a great deal of food on Mount Zhongnan… While we’re at it, let’s wipe out every edible thing there.”

hunks.baseline: *At minimum, it would be a swarm of locusts.*
hunks.sol: *At the very least, they’d be a swarm of locusts.*

hunks.sol: “Do you think this old man would stand by and watch such a thing happen? I will personally demand that the Gang Leader punish both of you!”

hunks.sol: “My Master, the Dragon-Head Gang Leader, has told me again and again: we may not have homes, but does that mean we have no pride? Great Hero Hwangbo, you have insulted a beggar’s pride.”

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t easy to look that cool and that pathetic at the same time, but he pulled it off effortlessly.

hunks.sol: *Maybe he really is good at begging.*

hunks.sol: With a voice overflowing with tragic grandeur and words that made him sound utterly penniless, Gung Gibang dominated the room before turning to Heukgeol Beggar.
